name: BoundingBox Warp Mirror
description: Adds a BoundingBox overlay button that opens a mirror-direction dialog and applies a one-shot whole-object Warp Deformer mirror, optionally preserving descendant geometry.

permissions.reason: Reads the current selection, Warp Deformer grids, and descendant evaluated geometry to prepare the mirror and compensation.
Writes the mirrored Warp grid and compensated descendant forms inside one native authoring transaction that joins Undo/Redo.
Contributes the mirror entry button to the native bounding-box overlay.
